✨ scryer | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated media library management and organization, with a particular focus on efficient handling of anime content.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted media management for movies, TV series, and anime • Monitors libraries and tracked titles • Searches for releases through indexers • Evaluates releases against quality and rules policies • Coordinates downloads and imports
📖 Summary: Scryer is a self-hosted media management application written in Rust, designed to efficiently handle movies, TV series, and anime. It automates the process of monitoring libraries, searching for releases, evaluating quality, coordinating downloads, organizing files, and managing subtitles, all within a single, compiled binary.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 CoolText | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Programmatically generating custom text-based images and logos using Python.
✨ Key Features: • Python wrapper for CoolText.com API • Build typed payloads for image generation • Post to CoolText's /PostChange endpoint • Get rendered image URL • Download rendered image locally
📖 Summary: This Python library acts as a wrapper for the CoolText.com API, allowing users to programmatically generate custom text-based images. It simplifies the process of creating stylized text logos by enabling developers to specify logo styles, text content, colors, and other parameters through Python code and receive image URLs or downloaded image files.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 obs-lite | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A simple, efficient, and user-friendly screen recording solution for Windows users, particularly those familiar with OBS Studio, who need a portable tool for capturing video and audio without extensive setup.
✨ Key Features: • Lightweight and portable (~7 MB .exe) • OBS Studio-like interface • Hardware H.264 encoding to MP4 • Desktop audio and microphone recording • Pause recording functionality
📖 Summary: obs-lite is a lightweight, portable screen recording application for Windows, designed with a familiar OBS Studio-like interface. It focuses on efficient hardware H.264 encoding to MP4, capturing desktop audio and microphone input, and offers features like pause functionality and global hotkeys, all within a single executable file.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ universal-modder | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To empower AI coding agents to automatically create mods for a wide range of PC games, simplifying the modding process and enabling creative content generation.
✨ Key Features: • AI-driven game modding • Game recon and reverse engineering • AI-generated art, 3D, and audio assets using fal.ai • In-game testing capabilities • Video showcase generation
📖 Summary: Universal Modder is a Python-based framework that enables AI coding agents to automatically generate mods for PC games. It provides skills and tools for game recon, reverse engineering, asset creation (art, 3D, audio), in-game testing, and video generation, fostering a community for sharing and remixing mods.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ BetterYoutube | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance the user experience on YouTube and YouTube Music by providing unobtrusive script-based modifications that fix common annoyances and declutter the interface.
✨ Key Features: • Lightweight, open-source userscripts • Improves YouTube and YouTube Music browsing experience • Prevents 'Video paused. Continue watching?' popups • Restores hidden queues in Mixes and playlists • MutationObserver-based for efficiency
📖 Summary: BetterYoutube is a collection of JavaScript userscripts designed to enhance the YouTube and YouTube Music experience by decluttering the interface and preventing common annoyances. It offers lightweight solutions to issues like video pausing and hidden playlists.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 kharos | Luau
🎯 Primary Use Case: A real-time strategy game playable in a web browser, focusing on base building, resource management, logistics, and combat with procedural generation and unique code-generated visuals.
✨ Key Features: • Procedural map generation with multiple biomes and terrain effects • Asset-less pixel art generated by shaders and code • Dynamic weather and day/night cycles
📖 Summary: Kharos is a multiplayer browser-based RTS game built with Luau and Rust, featuring procedural map generation, complex economy and logistics systems, and tactical combat. It emphasizes a unique 'pixel art without assets' approach where graphics and sound are synthesized by code.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
